summary: Practise secure records handling, repository controls and incident reporting. Explore this five-day cybersecurity training course.
lede: Cybersecurity awareness for information professionals focuses on reducing exposure as records, research files and shared knowledge move through everyday workflows. Designed for records officers, information managers and knowledge professionals, it helps learners map information risks, apply classification and access practices, and document suspicious activity for incident hand-offs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage information assets or guide the people who create, store and share them. It suits intermediate learners with working familiarity in an information-handling role.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with records, information services, knowledge management or document workflows is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
